description: This file defines a PHP class 'CandidateVacancyDecorator' which provides methods to set vacancy and candidate references by ID, and retrieve the status of a candidate vacancy, functioning as a decorator for the CandidateVacancy entity within the recruitment system.

classes.name: CandidateVacancyDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for CandidateVacancy entity, providing methods to set related entities by ID and retrieve status information.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a CandidateVacancy entity.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the Vacancy reference of the CandidateVacancy entity by vacancy ID.

methods.name: setCandidateById
methods.description: Sets the Candidate reference of the CandidateVacancy entity by candidate ID.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyStatus
methods.description: Returns an array with the ID and label representing the current status of the CandidateVacancy.
